label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled. User input flows from request headers -> param -> decoded param -> stored in map['keyB-34285'] -> retrieved by map.get('keyB-34285') assigned to bar -> bar.toCharArray() written to response writer. Although map also stores a safe value at 'keyA-34285', the sink explicitly retrieves the tainted value from 'keyB-34285'.

evidence.note: User input captured from request headers into param.
Tainted param stored in map under key 'keyB-34285'; safe value stored under 'keyA-34285'.
Sink resolves bar using map.get('keyB-34285'), retrieving the attacker-controlled value.
Sink writes bar.toCharArray() directly to response writer, causing XSS.
